verdict.rationale: Google Calendar ships a first-party RESTful API, reachable by direct HTTP calls or Google Client Libraries, that exposes most web-interface features, so calendars and events can be scripted without the UI. Nothing in the pack shows CI-specific use, such as non-interactive authentication, an official CLI or CI guidance. missing for 10: documented non-interactive/service-account auth for CI, official CLI or headless tooling, CI usage docs, independent hands-on corroboration of automated use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The Google Calendar API is a RESTful API that can be accessed through explicit HTTP calls or using the Google Client Libraries.
The API exposes most of the features available in the Google Calendar Web interface.
